findings.desc: computeWriteSet includes allowedTest but plan.md, checklist context, and userSees declare only allowedModify+allowedCreate: plan.md says dedupe(allowedModify++allowedCreate); scope-check feature says unions allowedModify+allowedCreate paths; userSees says unions a contract allowedModify+allowedCreate — none mention allowedTest. The implementation unions all three. Behavior is conservative (aligns with never-under-flag philosophy) and the verificationEvidence note acknowledges it, but the declared spec surface and implementation are inconsistent. If Story 2 callers rely on the plan-stated contract (allowedModify+allowedCreate only), the underdeclaration may cause confusion or test-file paths being unexpectedly included in overlap verdicts.
